A DEBT line is not an approval: it is a hole with a name, kept here so the ratchet stays green while the work is scheduled. Full triage and the decision it needs: docs/internal/route-scope-exemption-triage.md Since 2026-10-12 the gate asks the narrower question of Core 2026-11 AUTHZ-01: a middleware that names a principal CLASS (requireRole('agent'), requireExternalPrincipal, requireRoleOrScope('agent', …), workspaceAccess) no longer counts, because it admits every agent whatever its owner granted. Re-read 2026-10-16: the answers stamped 2026-08-16 were each read again against the route and the helpers it names, and rewritten so they are true today. An answer names its guard by function or handler, never by line number: by October most line citations pointed at other code.
